about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Computer Engineering student and aspiring Full-Stack Developer based in Warsaw, Poland.
about.paragraph2: My main focus is frontend development with JavaScript and React. I enjoy creating clean, responsive interfaces and turning ideas into practical web experiences.
about.paragraph3: I'm also exploring backend development, databases, and application architecture to understand how complete web applications are built.
